svg.title: AREA 09
svg.desc: The center is trapped; let an android shoot the traps or skirt the edge. Coordinate the piston switch with the warp player. One player warps, ignores enemies and takes the switch; call at the locked door so the team can operate the piston. Ignore enemies and shoot only the left target. Without a gun, clear the room and take the handgun from the side room. One player presses switches 1→2→3 to release each barrier; every other pad is a damage trap.
